# <span class="en">Analytical assumptions and methodological decisions</span><span class="zh">分析假设与方法决策</span> {#sec-assump}

## <span class="en">The model</span><span class="zh">模型</span>

::: {.en}
For origin $i$ and station $j$, the Huff probability [@huff1963] with a multiplicative
attractiveness is
:::

::: {.zh}
对起点 $i$ 与车站 $j$，采用乘法形式吸引力的 Huff 概率 [@huff1963] 为
:::

$$
P_{ij} = \frac{A_j\, d_{ij}^{\,\lambda}}{\sum_{k:\, d_{ik} \le D} A_k\, d_{ik}^{\,\lambda}},
\qquad
A_j = \exp\!\Big(\sum_m \beta_m x_{jm}\Big),
\qquad
E_j = \sum_i M_i\, P_{ij},
$$

::: {.en}
where $M_i$ is the local market, $x_{jm}$ the attraction variables, $\lambda$ the distance
exponent and $D$ a maximum access distance. It is calibrated separately for two purposes, and
the expected ridership is their sum:
:::

::: {.zh}
其中 $M_i$ 为本地市场，$x_{jm}$ 为吸引力变量，$\lambda$ 为距离指数，$D$ 为最大到达距离。模型按两种出行目的分别校准，预期客流是
两者之和：
:::

$$
T_j^{H} = \phi_j T_j, \qquad T_j^{W} = (1-\phi_j) T_j, \qquad \phi_j = \frac{\text{AM tap-ins}_j}{\text{AM tap-ins}_j + \text{AM tap-outs}_j}.
$$

::: {.en}
Parameters are found by minimising squared log errors, $\sum_j (\log T_j - \log E_j)^2$.
Ridership runs from under 200 to about 70,000 a day, and the stations this exercise cares about
most are at the bottom of that range; on the raw scale the fit would be decided by a dozen
interchanges. The calibration uses exact gradients in matrix form (`R/huff.R`), because the
validation and bootstrap need thousands of calibrations. @sec-calib-mci confirms that it gives
what `MCI::huff.shares()` gives [@wieland2017].
:::

::: {.zh}
参数通过最小化对数误差平方和 $\sum_j (\log T_j - \log E_j)^2$ 求得。客流从每日不足 200 到约 70,000 不等，而本研究最关心的车站
都处在这个范围的底部；若用原始尺度，拟合结果将由十几个换乘站决定。校准以矩阵形式使用精确梯度（`R/huff.R`），因为验证与自助法
需要进行数千次校准。@sec-calib-mci 确认其结果与 `MCI::huff.shares()` 的结果相同 [@wieland2017]。
:::

## <span class="en">Why two purposes</span><span class="zh">为什么区分两种目的</span>

::: {.en}
The Huff model describes people at an origin choosing a destination, and the obvious origin of a
rail trip is home. That works for a morning tap-in at Buangkok. It does not work for an evening
tap-in at Raffles Place, whose rider lives somewhere else entirely. A single model
of all tap-ins has no way to say this: to explain Raffles Place's `r n_fmt(stn("Raffles Place", "daily_in"), 0)` daily tap-ins, it must
assign it residents from across the island, and those long reaches are what later let a station
in Jurong take riders from the CBD. Splitting ridership by the morning balance gives each kind of
trip an origin it could plausibly start from. It is an approximation: the morning balance is not
the whole day's, and a station's visitors are not all commuters. It is, however, directly
observed for every station, and it reads as it should (@fig-ridership).
:::

::: {.zh}
Huff 模型描述的是某个起点的人选择目的地，而轨道出行最明显的起点是家。这适用于 Buangkok 的早晨进站，却不适用于 Raffles Place
的傍晚进站，因为这位乘客住在完全不同的地方。单一的全量进站模型无法表达这一点：为了解释 Raffles Place 每日
`r n_fmt(stn("Raffles Place", "daily_in"), 0)` 次进站，它只能把全岛各地的居民都分配给这个车站，而正是这种过远的辐射，使裕廊的车站后来能从 CBD 抢走
乘客。按早高峰的平衡拆分客流，使每类出行都有一个合理的起点。这只是近似：早高峰的平衡不等于全天的平衡，车站的访客也不都是通勤者。
但这个量对每个车站都是直接观测到的，而且结果也符合常理（@fig-ridership）。
:::
